text:
sam: quick note from support: a customer hit repeated throttles because their client libs didn't expose Retry-After consistently. They implemented a dumb 1s fixed retry and it made things worse.

nina: ouch. Which SDKs are the culprits?

sam: Java and Go currently only surface a plain RateLimitException string. Python/Node have structured fields.

ojas: we should land a cross-language contract: fields = ["code","message","http_status","retryable","retry_after_seconds","category"]. Example: ```json
{
  "code": "RATE_LIMIT",
  "message": "Too many requests",
  "http_status": 429,
  "retryable": true,
  "retry_after_seconds": 8,
  "category": "rate_limit"
}
```

morgan: also include a machine-friendly short code plus human message so apps can do switch/case easily.

nina: agree. For mapping table: 401/403 -> AUTH (retryable=false), 429 -> RATE_LIMIT (retryable=true), 502/503 -> SERVER_ERROR (retryable=true), network failures -> NETWORK (retryable=true). Streaming disconnects -> NETWORK with transient flag.

sam: ergonomics per language:
- Python/Node: exception attributes.
- Go: keep error interface but provide helpers: `IsRetryable(err) bool`, `RetryAfter(err) time.Duration`. Also an exported sentinel type for type assertions.
- Java: unchecked subclass with getters.

ojas: onboarding: update quickstart sample app to show correct backoff pattern: `if err.retryable { wait(err.retry_after_seconds ?? backoff.next()) }` and link to SDK helper utilities.

morgan: telemetry: SDK should emit tags `error.code` and `http_status` to metrics so we can aggregate by error reason. Also add `sdk.language` tag.

nina: compatibility plan: add fields non-breaking, keep old message for now. Document SDK versions that add typed errors. We'll need tests asserting `Retry-After` header precedence over heuristics.

sdk-bot: Created INF-4429: "SDK: unify error contract + helpers for retry/backoff" assigned to @ojas. <https://redwood.internal/INF-4429|link> :white_check_mark:

ojas: I'll draft the spec with examples for each language and a sample app demonstrating exponential backoff with server-specified pause. Planning node/python quick patch, go/java follow-ups next sprint.

sam: thanks. Nina/Docs: can you add a short doc in onboarding showing streaming reconnect guidance? A one-paragraph blurb would help.

nina: yep, will add a snippet and link to the issue.

morgan: once PRs land, we should run a small internal canary to watch for noisy retries.

ojas: filing PR now.
